title: RESTWS-1037: Fix PRIVILEGE_DENIED sentinel leaks into serialized lists, causing HTTP 500
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'RESTWS-738 Remove concept property setters from ObsResource classes' -->
<!--- 'RESTWS-JiraIssueNumber JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->
Stop PRIVILEGE_DENIED from leaking into serialized lists and maps; drop the whole property instead

 GET /visit/{uuid} returned HTTP 500 (No serializer found for class java.lang.Object) when a child resource overrode getRequiredGetPrivilege() and The caller lacked it
